sections.heading: How we ranked them

sections.heading: All 64 matching laptops at a glance
sections.body:
Of the 64 laptops that match, 56% have 16 GB of RAM or more, 56% have a 512 GB SSD or bigger, 100% have a touchscreen and 63% have a 10th-gen or newer processor (or an Apple M / Intel Core Ultra chip). Prices run from KSh 24,000 to KSh 285,000, with half below KSh 51,250. By brand: HP 34, Lenovo 18, Dell 12.

| Under KSh 51,250 (the median) | 32 |

sections.heading: How we ranked them
sections.body: Each laptop gets a spec score out of 42, read from its listing: processor class ×3 (Celeron 1, Core i3 2, Core i5 3, Core i7 / Core Ultra 5 4, Core i9 / Core Ultra 7 / Apple M 5), processor age ×2 (Intel 7th gen and older 0–1, 8th–9th gen 3, 10th 4, 11th 5, 12th 6, 13th gen, Core Ultra and Apple M 7), memory (8 GB 3, 16 GB 6, 24 GB+ 8) and storage (256 GB 2, 512 GB 4, 1 TB+ 5). Ties go to the lower price. Nobody paid for a place, and no laptop is ranked by hand. Specs are read from each product's listing as the shop typed it; where a listing does not state the memory or storage, the laptop scores 1 point for it and the con says so, so check the product page or ask us.

content.h1: MacBook vs Windows laptops: which to buy in Kenya
content.introduction: At ECB Technologies, the median MacBook laptop costs KSh 207,000 (11 in stock) and the median Windows laptops laptop costs KSh 52,000 (337 in stock). Windows laptops is KSh 155,000 cheaper at the median. The table below compares them on the specs that matter, using every laptop in stock, as of 15 November 2026.

sections.heading: MacBook: what you get
sections.body:
Apple's laptops; models with Apple M chips are fast, quiet and have long battery life. 2006: the first MacBook and MacBook Pro; 2008: MacBook Air; 2020: Apple's own M1 chip replaces Intel. We have 11 MacBook laptops from KSh 98,000 to KSh 324,000. The three best specified:

1. **[MacBook M5 Pro](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/item/macbook-m5-pro-24gb-1tb-ssd-142-space-black-wue8559s4v)**: KSh 322,000. Apple M-series · 24 GB RAM · 1 TB SSD. Spec score 42/42. Pros: 24 GB RAM, comfortable for many tabs and heavy apps; 1 TB SSD; current-generation Apple M-series processor.
2. **[MacBook Pro M5](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/item/macbook-pro-m5-10-core-cpu-10-core-gpu-16gb-1tb-ssd-142-liquid-retina-nkw8375xzw)**: KSh 285,000. Apple M-series · 16 GB RAM · 1 TB SSD. Spec score 40/42. Pros: 16 GB RAM, comfortable for many tabs and heavy apps; 1 TB SSD; current-generation Apple M-series processor.
3. **[MacBook Air M5](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/item/macbook-air-m5-16gb-512gb-ssd-136-nqu8217q0b)**: KSh 185,000. Apple M-series · 16 GB RAM · 512 GB SSD. Spec score 39/42. Pros: 16 GB RAM, comfortable for many tabs and heavy apps; 512 GB SSD; current-generation Apple M-series processor.

sections.heading: Windows laptops: what you get

Core Ultra · 32 GB RAM · 1 TB SSD · 2-in-1. Spec score 42/42. Pros: 32 GB RAM, comfortable for many tabs and heavy apps; 1 TB SSD; current-generation Core Ultra processor.

Core Ultra · 32 GB RAM · 2 TB SSD · 2-in-1. Spec score 42/42. Pros: 32 GB RAM, comfortable for many tabs and heavy apps; 2 TB SSD; current-generation Core Ultra processor.
3. **[HP Omnibook Ultra Flip 14-FH000 2-in-1](https://www.ecbtechkenya.com/item/hp-omnibook-ultra-flip-14-fh000-2-in-1-core-ultra-7-32gb-2tb-ssd-x360-stylus-pen-wje9637i4u)**: KSh 220,500. Core Ultra · 32 GB RAM · 2 TB SSD · 2-in-1. Spec score 42/42. Pros: 32 GB RAM, comfortable for many tabs and heavy apps; 2 TB SSD; current-generation Core Ultra processor.

sections.heading: Which should you buy?
sections.body:
- **Tight budget:** Windows laptops. Its median is KSh 52,000 and the cheapest is KSh 16,000.
- **For multitasking and heavy apps:** Windows laptops (more of its models have 16 GB RAM or more).
- **For the longest software support:** MacBook (more of its models have a 10th-gen or newer processor).
- **For touch and pen use:** Windows laptops (more of its models have a touchscreen).
- **Highest spec available:** MacBook, up to KSh 324,000.

sections.heading: Verdict
sections.body: Windows laptops costs less at the median (KSh 52,000 against KSh 207,000). Windows laptops leads on multitasking and heavy apps; MacBook leads on the longest software support; Windows laptops leads on touch and pen use. Either way, compare the exact model: the spread inside each group is wider than the gap between them.

sections.heading: How we compared them
sections.body: Every MacBook and Windows laptops laptop in stock is counted, not a sample. Shares are of each side's own total. The best picks use the same spec score as our lists: processor class ×3 (Celeron 1, Core i3 2, Core i5 3, Core i7 / Core Ultra 5 4, Core i9 / Core Ultra 7 / Apple M 5), processor age ×2 (Intel 7th gen and older 0–1, 8th–9th gen 3, 10th 4, 11th 5, 12th 6, 13th gen, Core Ultra and Apple M 7), memory (8 GB 3, 16 GB 6, 24 GB+ 8) and storage (256 GB 2, 512 GB 4, 1 TB+ 5). Ties go to the lower price. Nobody paid for a place, and no laptop is ranked by hand.
